ggsegMcalt 1.0.1

MCALT Subcortical Atlas

Source: R/data.R
mcalt_subcortical.Rd

Subcortical parcellation from the Mayo Clinic Adult Lifespan Template (MCALT) ADIR122 atlas.

mcalt_subcortical()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (subcortical).

References

Schwarz CG, et al. (2017). Alzheimer's & Dementia, 13(7):P1071. doi:10.1016/j.jalz.2017.06.1071

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: mcalt_cortical()

Examples

mcalt_subcortical()
#> 
#> ── mcalt_subcortical ggseg atlas ───────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: subcortical
#> Regions: 19
#> Hemispheres: NA

#> sagittal
#> Palette: ✔

#> ✔ ggseg3d (meshes)

#> # A tibble: 19 × 3
#>    hemi  region      label      
#>    <chr> <chr>       <chr>      
#>  1 NA    region 0021 region_0021
